definitions.explanation: Complete disappearance or ceasing to exist. Used for the dying out of species, civilizations, or organizations, as well as the legal termination of rights or obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消滅|しょうめつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{消滅|しょうめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Many languages are in danger of extinction.

examples.japanese: {時効|じこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成立|せいりつ}する→成立する：25497_seiritsusuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{請求権|せいきゅうけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消滅|しょうめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the statute of limitations is reached, the right to claim is extinguished.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word with a strong sense of finality — something ceasing to exist completely. More absolute than ⟦{消失|しょうしつ}→消失：13351_shoushitsu⟧ (disappearance), which can imply something simply vanishing from view. {消滅|しょうめつ} implies permanent, irreversible disappearance.

In legal contexts, used for the termination or expiration of rights, contracts, or obligations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消滅|しょうめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become extinct, to disappear
- {消滅|しょうめつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧: danger of extinction
- {時効|じこう}{消滅|しょうめつ}: expiration by statute of limitations
- ⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{消滅|しょうめつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a right is extinguished
